title: Pre-dynastic Maadi lion cult around the Sphinx

tellings.quote: Well, you have the Mi culture that lived in the area of Giza. And I've always thought that it it was perfectly possible that the Sphinx could have been their god

plain: A researcher named Luke Caverns suggests that the Sphinx at Giza may have been the god of the Maadi, a people who lived around Giza before the age of the pharaohs. He tells Michels, without naming a source, that he has "always thought that it was perfectly possible that the Sphinx could have been their god", which would make the monument far older than the dynasties usually credited with it.
